## How the content is organized

Source lives under `content/`. Each first-level directory is a **part** in the sidebar:

| Folder | Role |
|--------|------|
| `content/00-intro/` | Orientation and overview |
| `content/01-foundations/` | Core material |
| `content/99-appendices/` | Optional extras (add when needed) |
| `content/_planning/` | Notes only — ignored by the index script |

Chapter order is filename order. Prefer numeric prefixes:

```text
content/01-foundations/01-getting-started.qmd
content/01-foundations/02-core-ideas.qmd
```

Set sidebar titles with YAML frontmatter:

```yaml
---
title: "Getting Started"
---
```

## Formats

This book is published as part of the monorepo library portal:

- **HTML** — primary reading experience (light/dark themes)
- **PDF** / **EPUB** — generated on full library builds
